verdict.rationale: Adding generated sound effects, ambient audio, or scene-matched music is a fair question for an AI video creation tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any of these. The closest items are AI narration and avatars (docs-11) and uploading your own script audio via API (docs-16). Narration is a different capability, and uploading audio is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.
